text: Eating well, staying active, and getting enough rest are the foundations of a healthy life. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the energy it needs, while regular exercise strengthens your heart and muscles. But true health also depends on your mental state. Taking time to relax, practicing mindfulness, or simply talking to a friend can reduce stress. Equally important is work-life balance—setting boundaries so that work doesn’t consume your personal time. Remember, small daily choices, like a short walk or an early night, add up. Prioritize yourself, and your body and mind will thank you.
